mentions.name: Kronicler
mentions.description: A Python performance capture library that records real-time performance metrics from backend systems. Functions are instrumented with an @kronicler.capture decorator (plus FastAPI middleware), and metrics are stored in a custom columnar database written in Rust. Logs can be exposed via a /logs server route returning DB.logs(), and metrics can be viewed with charts in the usekronicler.com online dashboard. Work on concurrency and other improvements is ongoing.
mentions.problem: I/O operations get costly when writing lots of performance data to disk, and building good real-time analytics tools takes a lot of time.
mentions.audience: Python backend developers who need visibility into the performance of the backend systems they maintain.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is why I wrote kronicler to record performance metrics while being fast and simple to implement. I built my own columnar database in Rust to capture and analyze these logs.
